assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Tips Official 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Tips Industries / Tips Films。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言（印地语）。
  6. 主要内容类别（音乐／宝莱坞）。
  7. 内容供应模式：授权音乐曲库。
  8. 代表作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Tips Official 排名第 41 名，历史累计观看量约为 59B（590 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Tips Official 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
COMPREHENSIVE DOSSIER FOR TIPS OFFICIAL YOUTUBE CHANNEL

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID AND CANONICAL URL
  • Channel ID: UCJrDMFOdv1I2k8n9oK_V21w
  • Canonical handle URL: https://www.youtube.com/@tipsofficial
  • Channel-ID URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJrDMFOdv1I2k8n9oK_V21w
    Sources: YouTube search result snippet showing @tipsofficial with 82.4M subscribers; Communitrics direct page link.
  1. OPERATOR & CORPORATE CHAIN
  • Operated by: Tips Music Limited (formerly Tips Industries Limited, renamed 12 September 2024)
  • Founded: 1975 by Kumar S. Taurani and Ramesh S. Taurani as Jaihind Electronics trading firm; partnership firm Tips Cassettes & Records Co registered 1988; converted to public limited company 1996; went public 1 July 1999
  • Tips Films Limited: wholly-owned subsidiary acquired 11 June 2003, merged with Tips Industries effective 1 April 2005; film division demerged back into separate Tips Films Limited effective 23 March 2022 via NCLT Mumbai order
  • CIN: L92120MH1996PLC099359
    Sources: tips.in/contact; indiainfoline.com/company/tips-music-ltd/summary; mnacritique.mergersindia.com
  1. CREATION DATE AND EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
  • Channel created: 22 May 2007 (2007-05-22T10:13:28Z)
  • Earliest still-public upload: 'Hello Koi Hai Kuch Kaho Na - Speed' (Urmila Matondkar, Zayed Khan), uploaded 25 May 2007, currently 97,421 views
    Sources: Kaggle YouTube channels dataset; YouTube video page (youtube.com/watch?v=o9lmBEpnLso)
  1. OPERATING LOCATION AND DISPLAYED COUNTRY
  • Displayed country: India (🇮🇳)
  • Registered office: 601, Durga Chambers, 6th Floor, Linking Road, Khar (West), Mumbai 400 052
  • Corporate office: 2nd Floor, Raheja Chambers, Linking Road, Santacruz (West), Mumbai 400 054
    Sources: Communitrics channel page; tips.in/contact
  1. LANGUAGES
  • Primary language: Hindi
    Sources: Wikipedia List of most-viewed YouTube channels; Communitrics
  1. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
  • Categories: Music / Entertainment (Bollywood Hindi songs, jukeboxes, lyric videos)
    Sources: Communitrics ('Music, Entertainment'); Wikipedia ('Entertainment')
  1. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL: LICENSED MUSIC CATALOG
  • Tips Music licenses its catalogue of 25,000+ songs to digital platforms
  • Google/YouTube deal (2020): Tips licensed catalogue for YouTube Shorts; 'Tips will license its large catalogue to YouTube platform allowing the huge Indian Diaspora across the world to create content inspired by its ever popular and superhit music library'
  • Facebook/Instagram deal (December 2020): Global licensing agreement allowing users to add Tips music to posts/stories/reels
  • YouTube channel receives 5+ billion views per month (per Warner Music Group, Tips' partner)
    Sources: timesofindia.indiatimes.com article; musicbusinessworldwide.com article
  1. REPRESENTATIVE WORKS (most-viewed uploads)
  • 'Tere Naal Love Ho Gaya' Video Jukebox — ~268M views
  • 'Pehli Nazar Mein Kaise Jaado Kar Diya | Race' — ~226M views
  • 'Pardesi Pardesi Jana Nahi | Raja Hindustani' — ~204M views
  • 'Choti Si Pyari Si Nanhi Si | Anari' — ~74M views
  • 'Party On My Mind | Race 2' — ~69M views
    Sources: YouTube search results with view counts from video pages

NOTE ON VIEW COUNT DISCREPANCY: The orchestrator cites '~59B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026'. Communitrics' actual September 2, 2026 snapshot records 58,677,038,621 views (~58.7B) at global rank #34 (by subscribers). Wikipedia's 'most-viewed channels' list shows rank #40 with 56.2B views (different methodology/timeframe). All sources consistently place Tips Official among the top 45 most-viewed YouTube channels globally.
